[[File:Jocasta.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Jocasta Nu wore a robe featuring an Ansata pattern.]]
An '''Ansata pattern''' was a type of visual design. A traditional Ansata pattern that symbolized knowledge was depicted on the [[Robe/Legends|robe]] [[Clothing/Legends|worn]] by [[Director/Legends|Director]] of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]].<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The [[Jedi apparel/Legends|apparel]] of [[Atris]],<ref name="KOTOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> and even moreso that worn by [[Tionne Solusar]],<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> bore patterns that shared similarities with those of Nu.<ref name="KOTOR2" /><ref name="JvS" />
